high_level_description: The image depicts a couple dressed in traditional Indian attire, standing close together against a backdrop of large green leaves and hanging floral decorations. The woman is wearing a peach-colored saree with intricate silver and gold embroidery along the borders. She has her hair styled in a braid adorned with orange flowers, and she is accessorized with multiple necklaces and earrings. The man is dressed in a white kurta with a matching white shawl draped over his shoulders. He has a beard and is smiling warmly.
